# Copilot instructions

This project's instructions for AI coding agents are in `README.md`: start at **"For AI coding agents: read
this first"** and read the **hard rules** and the **table of contents** of every doc in the repo (what each covers and
when to read it) before you change anything. Then read the docs it lists for your task.

Never push to the deploy branch `ccr-63b8112a-e2uk2g`. Work on a feature branch, open a PR and keep `npm test` green.
Update the matching doc and that area's running log in `docs/logs/` in the same PR.

Keep this file a pointer: put new rules in README.md (hard rules only) and everything else in the docs it lists, not
here, so the agent files never drift apart.
